business_description: Stable row identifier for the source adapter row.
validation_rule: Must be unique inside the adapter file.

business_description: Program code or candidate code that ties usage/value evidence to the funded or candidate AI program.
validation_rule: Approved/funded rows must reconcile to 09 or SA04; candidates must be marked not approved.

business_description: Stable AI use case identifier used to join to dimension 10.
validation_rule: Must be present for rows consumed by Intelligence or Moves.

business_description: Name of the AI tool, product capability, agent, or platform capability being measured.
validation_rule: Cannot be blank when usage metrics are populated.

business_description: Start date for the usage measurement window.
validation_rule: Must be on or before usage_period_end.

business_description: End date for the usage measurement window.
validation_rule: Must be on or after usage_period_start.

business_description: Users or seats licensed for the AI tool during the period.
validation_rule: Must be >= enabled_users when both are provided.

business_description: Users enabled or provisioned for the AI tool.
validation_rule: Must be >= active_users when both are provided.

business_description: Users who actually used the AI capability in the period.
validation_rule: Usage-measured rows require active_users or usage_events.

business_description: Active users divided by enabled users, or a source-system equivalent adoption metric.
validation_rule: Must be between 0 and 100.

business_description: Prompts, actions, agent conversations, accepted suggestions, transactions touched, or source-specific usage event count.
validation_rule: Must be non-negative.

business_description: Business or delivery metric before the AI capability was deployed.
validation_rule: Every value claim needs a baseline metric.

business_description: Target metric value or target metric name from the business case.
validation_rule: Every promised value needs a target.

business_description: Measured current-state metric value from telemetry or operations reports.
validation_rule: Finance-validated or realized claims require actual_metric.

business_description: Business-case or vendor-promised value; not realized value.
validation_rule: Must not be displayed as realized value.

business_description: Finance-attested partial or full value validated against actuals.
validation_rule: Required before any realized-value claim.

business_description: Claim gate status for the row.
validation_rule: realized_value_allowed requires usage, KPI actual, finance value, and evidence.

business_description: Recommended action for the program or use case based on usage and value proof.
validation_rule: Candidates with no funding should be freeze or needs_evidence.

business_description: System of record or export source for the telemetry.
validation_rule: Must identify where the usage/value evidence comes from.

business_description: Whether a named business/IT/finance owner has attested the metric.
validation_rule: Finance-attested value requires finance_attested.
